BriefDescription: Counts the number of cycles that the head (oldest load) of the load buffer is stalled due to any number of reasons, including an L1 miss, WCB full, pagewalk, store address block or store data block.

Counts the number of cycles that the head (oldest load) of the load buffer is stalled due to any number of reasons, including an L1 miss, WCB full, pagewalk, store address block or store data block, on a load that retires.

Counts the number of cycles that the head (oldest load) of the load buffer is stalled due to a core bound stall including a store address match, a DTLB miss or a page walk that detains the load from retiring.
Counts the number of cycles that the head (oldest load) of the load buffer is stalled due to a DL1 miss.
Counts the number of cycles that the head (oldest load) of the load buffer and retirement are both stalled due to a DL1 miss.
Counts the number of cycles that the head (oldest load) of the load buffer is stalled due to other block cases.
PublicDescription: Counts the number of cycles that the head (oldest load) of the load buffer is stalled due to other block cases such as pipeline conflicts, fences, etc.

BriefDescription: Counts the number of cycles that the head (oldest load) of the load buffer and retirement are both stalled due to other block cases.
PublicDescription: Counts the number of cycles that the head (oldest load) of the load buffer and retirement are both stalled due to other block cases such as pipeline conflicts, fences, etc.

BriefDescription: Counts the number of cycles that the head (oldest load) of the load buffer is stalled due to a pagewalk.
Counts the number of cycles that the head (oldest load) of the load buffer and retirement are both stalled due to a pagewalk.
Counts the number of cycles that the head (oldest load) of the load buffer is stalled due to a store address match.
Counts the number of cycles that the head (oldest load) of the load buffer and retirement are both stalled due to a store address match.
Counts the number of cycles that the head (oldest load) of the load buffer is stalled due to store data forward block.
Counts the number of cycles that the head (oldest load) of the load buffer and retirement are both stalled due to a store data forward block.
Counts the number of cycles that the head (oldest load) of the load buffer is stalled due to request buffers full or lock in progress.
Counts the number of cycles that the head (oldest load) of the load buffer and retirement are both stalled due to request buffers full or lock in progress.
Counts the number of machine clears due to memory ordering caused by a snoop from an external agent. Does not count internally generated machine clears such as those due to memory disambiguation.
Counts the number of machine clears that flush the pipeline and restart the machine without the use of microcode.
Counts misaligned loads that are 4K page splits.
Counts misaligned stores that are 4K page splits.
Counts demand instruction fetches and L1 instruction cache prefetches that were not supplied by the L3 cache.
Counts demand instruction fetches and L1 instruction cache prefetches that were not supplied by the L3 cache.

Counts demand instruction fetches and L1 instruction cache prefetches that missed the L3 Cache and were supplied by the local socket (DRAM or PMM), whether or not in Sub NUMA Cluster(SNC) Mode.  In SNC Mode counts PMM or DRAM accesses that are controlled by the close or distant SNC Cluster.  It does not count misses to the L3 which go to Local CXL Type 2 Memory or Local Non DRAM.
Counts demand data reads that were not supplied by the L3 cache.
Counts demand data reads that were not supplied by the L3 cache.

Counts demand data reads that missed the L3 Cache and were supplied by the local socket (DRAM or PMM), whether or not in Sub NUMA Cluster(SNC) Mode.  In SNC Mode counts PMM or DRAM accesses that are controlled by the close or distant SNC Cluster.  It does not count misses to the L3 which go to Local CXL Type 2 Memory or Local Non DRAM.
Counts demand read for ownership (RFO) requests and software prefetches for exclusive ownership (PREFETCHW) that were not supplied by the L3 cache.
Counts demand read for ownership (RFO) requests and software prefetches for exclusive ownership (PREFETCHW) that were not supplied by the L3 cache.

Counts demand read for ownership (RFO) requests and software prefetches for exclusive ownership (PREFETCHW) that missed the L3 Cache and were supplied by the local socket (DRAM or PMM), whether or not in Sub NUMA Cluster(SNC) Mode.  In SNC Mode counts PMM or DRAM accesses that are controlled by the close or distant SNC Cluster.  It does not count misses to the L3 which go to Local CXL Type 2 Memory or Local Non DRAM.
Counts full streaming stores (64 bytes, WCiLF) that were not supplied by the L3 cache.
Counts all hardware prefetches that were not supplied by the L3 cache.
Counts all hardware prefetches that were not supplied by the L3 cache.

OCR.ITOM.L3_MISS_LOCAL - Counts requests for exclusive ownership of a cacheline with no data transfer and atomically writes the cacheline back to the fabric, guarantees that the entire line will be modified (ItoM, SpecItoM) were not supplied by the L3 cache.
Counts partial streaming stores (less than 64 bytes, WCiL) that were not supplied by the L3 cache.
Counts all data read, code read, and RFO requests including demands and prefetches (written to the L1 cache or L2 cache) that were not supplied by the L3 cache.
Counts all data read, code read, and RFO requests including demands and prefetches (written to the L1 cache or L2 cache) that were not supplied by the L3 cache.

Counts streaming stores that were not supplied by the L3 cache.

Counts L1 data cache software prefetch requests which include T0/T1/T2 and NTA that were not supplied by the L3 cache.
